title: SwiGLU feed-forward network
summary: Inspect a standalone dense decoder whose SwiGLU width is 2D; this is a single configuration lesson, not a campaign.

steps.explanation: Each token independently uses gate and up projections from D to F, multiplies silu(gate) by up, then projects F back to D.
observe: FFN width changes per-token parameter and compute shape; no dedicated FFN architecture metric is emitted.

prerequisites: Prepare the selected tokenizer and data only if training.
try_changes: Predict F and the three projection shapes before probing.
Try 4D, 2D, and D with the ordinary configuration, changing one width at a time.
Compare learned training and held-out wording separately after a short run.
limits: FFN width changes capacity and optimization conditions; this lesson does not establish a quality or efficiency winner.
The dense reference implementation makes no fused-kernel performance claim.
